$comment: HAND-CURATED catalog for the cnadnr-ro adapter (CameraDirectoryPort). CNADNR/CNAIR ('Compania Nationala de Administrare a Infrastructurii Rutiere' — the Romanian national road authority) publishes a small set of live traffic-camera pages at https://www.cnadnr.ro/ro/trafic-live with NO API and NO machine-readable lat/lon — this file IS the catalog (there is nothing upstream to scrape/paginate). Verified 2026-07-17 by fetching https://www.cnadnr.ro/ro/trafic-live (HTTP 200) and curl-checking every href below individually (HTTP 200, verified 2026-07-17). The site currently lists exactly 5 camera pages — 3 at Fetesti (A2 motorway, Bucuresti<->Constanta, both directions over the Danube crossing) and 2 at Giurgiu (the DN5 Giurgiu-Ruse Danube border crossing into Bulgaria) — so this catalog has 5 entries, not padded to a larger count. Coordinates are CURATED APPROXIMATIONS at town/landmark level (~2-decimal precision), geocoded from well-known public knowledge of these Romanian locations, NOT scraped or machine-extracted (there is no coordinate field on the CNADNR pages). Cameras at the same physical crossing (the 3 Fetesti cameras; the 2 Giurgiu cameras) intentionally share one town-level pin — do not read this as sub-meter precision.
